{{Top}}
[[File:Lukenohandsma.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] loses his hand.]]
'''Dismemberment''' involved the loss of one or more [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], such as the hand, foot, arm, or leg.<ref name="Galactic Campaign Guide">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The loss of the head was sometimes referred to as dismemberment, but was more accurately described as [[Sai cha/Legends|beheading]] or decapitation. Dismemberment usually occurred in combat, especially when [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] were involved. In fact, certain [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] techniques existed which focused on dismemberment and were used by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. They were called [[Lightsaber combat/Legends#Marks of Contact|Marks of Contact]].<ref name="The Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> Examples included ''[[Cho mai/Legends|cho mai]]'' which was the cutting off of the opponent's weapon hand, and ''[[Cho sun/Legends|cho sun]]'' which was the act of cutting off an opponent's weapon arm. ''[[Cho mok/Legends|Cho mok]]'' was the act of cutting off an opponent's limb, usually the leg.<ref name="The Jedi Path" /> ''[[Mou kei/Legends|Mou kei]]'' was a variant generally forbidden by the Jedi since it involved cutting through several limbs at once.<ref name="The Jedi Path" /> For the Jedi, the use of dismemberment in lightsaber combat was to end a battle without resorting to killing the opponent.<ref name="The Jedi Path" /> Collectively, the Jedi techniques to dismember an opponent rather than killing them was called a '''severing strike.'''<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

[[File:LukeHand.png|thumb|left|250px|Luke Skywalker's prosthetic hand.]]
Although it was a grievous injury, dismemberment was not necessarily fatal. A lost limb could be restored with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] limb.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> Some cybernetic replacements, such as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] cybernetic arm, looked identical to the original body parts, while others were immediately recognizable as artificial.<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> In addition, some species were able to regrow lost limbs. [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]]<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> and [[Gand/Legends|Gands]]<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref> were able to regrow lost limbs in a few days, while [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]]<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> were able to regrow lost limbs in only a few minutes. Dismemberment in [[Droid/Legends|droids]] was less serious, since they could generally be repaired. For example, in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was dismembered but was eventually put back together, becoming fully functional once again.<ref name="Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back">{{Film|V}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The first 6 ''[[Star Wars]]'' movies feature dismemberment, of either organic or [[Cybernetics/Legends|artificial]] limbs. [[Rob Coleman]] discusses this in the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] commentary track ("Yet another in the series of Star Wars severed limbs. I've actually tried to talk to [[George Lucas|George]] about the whole reason for the severed limbs in these movies and he always just sort of smiles and chuckles and never gives me the real answer.") and when asked by ''Vanity Fair'' about the dismemberments, George Lucas answered: "That's what happens when you play with [[Lightsaber/Legends|swords]]."

*{{Film|I}}: [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] cuts [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] in half after Maul kills [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] in the Theed Powerplant.
*{{Film|II}}: [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] cuts [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell's]] hand and an [[Acklay/Legends|Acklay's]] leg off, [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] cuts off [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] right forearm. Mace Windu decapitates Jango Fett in the stadium battle.
*{{Film|III}}: Anakin severs Dooku's hands (Then he decapitates him), [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] hand and cuts [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] in half, [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] severs a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper's]] arm outside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], [[Zett Jukassa/Legends|Zett Jukassa]] cuts clone's legs, Obi-Wan cuts off two of [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' cybernetic hands and, during the [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|Duel on Mustafar]], Anakin's legs and remaining (organic) arm.
*{{Film|IV}}: [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] briefly loses an arm during a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] attack, Obi-Wan slices off [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba's]] arm.
*{{Film|V}}: A [[One-Arm|Wampa]] loses an arm to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] lightsaber, C-3PO is completely dismembered on Bespin, Darth Vader cuts off Luke's right hand.
*{{Film|VI}}: Luke cuts through Darth Vader's cybernetic right arm.
